title: Vault Security Staircase Descent
description: You are descending a secure vault staircase with n steps. Each time you can either descend 1 step or 2 steps. Determine how many distinct ways you can reach the bottom of the staircase.
input_format: An integer n representing the total number of steps.
output_format: An integer representing the number of distinct ways to descend.

examples.explanation: There are two ways to descend 2 steps: (1+1) or (2).
There are three ways to descend 3 steps: (1+1+1), (1+2), or (2+1).
There are 8 distinct combinations of steps to descend 5 stairs.
